scope: Stationary validation of an intentionally repositioned support; not full L3 delivery
sequence: Apply real wheel motion to reposition support
When measured angle >= 1.10 rad, tool-only width >= .70 m and native contacts exist, freeze the measured candidate pose before verification
Command zero wheel twist and verify stationary active support for 2 continuous seconds
stability_reference: Measured post-action candidate pose, recorded before the first stationary validation sample
previous_contract: Earlier trials used displacement from the pre-fault pose; preserve their failed verdicts and do not retroactively rescore them
change_reason: The v4 controller remained below its 1.18 rad braking trigger and never attempted stationary verification. Trigger braking at 1.10 rad; final acceptance minimum remains 1.05 rad.
